The candle flares behind his face as the camera pushes in.

[Shot 3] At 00:07.800, pale dawn light falls through the lattice window and the shot widens. <Subject 1> (S1) sits at the table, the empty wine bowl before him, hands resting empty on the tabletop. He sings <d>[Chinese] 生与死 一切成空</d> at 00:09.500 with his lips rounding and narrowing on the final soft vowel, then falls silent as the camera pulls back to reveal misty mountains through the window. A rapid drum roll builds and a flash-white lands on the downbeat at 00:11.100.

[Shot 4] At 00:11.100, a rapid jump-cut lands on the downbeat as the chorus begins. <Subject 1> (S1) runs through a rain-washed old alley under amber street lamps, robes and ponytail streaming behind him, his hands empty and swinging naturally at his sides. The camera tracks alongside him at running pace, the lamps flaring past in long streaks.

[Shot 5] At 00:19.900, a strobe-accented cut moves to the top of the highest rooftop under the night sky. <Subject 1> (S1) throws his head back and sings out across the city, <d>[Chinese] 狂笑一声 长叹一声 快活一生 悲哀一生</d> at 00:19.900, his mouth opening wide and his jaw dropping fully on each sustained vowel, a wild, laughing edge to the phrase, then a sudden stillness as he lowers his gaze, and <d>[Chinese] 谁与我生死与共</d> at 00:25.000 with his lips finishing the phrase and holding. The camera performs an arc shot with large amplitude around him at a steady pace, the city lights strobing across the lens. A flash-white lands at 00:30.900.

[Shot 6] At 00:30.900, the chorus repeats with a flash-white transition onto a moon-white mist field where dark figures stand in ranks at the edges of the frame. <Subject 1> (S1) walks slowly through them, alone, hands resting at his sides, robes and ponytail moving in the wind. He sings <d>[Chinese] 来也匆匆 去也匆匆 恨不能相逢</d> at 00:30.900 with crisp lip closure on each phrase, and <d>[Chinese] 爱也匆匆 恨也匆匆 一切都随风</d> at 00:34.500 as the figures dissolve into mist behind him. The camera pulls back slowly.

[Shot 7] At 00:37.800, a strobe-accented cut moves to a wind-scoured field at the edge of a cliff under a blood-red dusk sky. <Subject 1> (S1) stands alone, robes and ponytail streaming in the wind, hands empty and relaxed at his sides. He sings <d>[Chinese] 狂笑一声 长叹一声 快活一生 悲哀一生</d> at 00:37.800 with a wide, sustained jaw drop on each phrase, and <d>[Chinese] 谁与我生死与共</d> at 00:41.800 with his eyes closing on the first word while his lips keep articulating, the final vowel drawing out long into the wind until 00:44.800. The camera pulls back slowly, the field dissolving into mist behind him.

[Shot 8] At 00:44.800, the picture holds on the empty cliff as the instrumental outro plays: <Subject 1> (S1) stands at a distance with his back to the lens, no longer singing, his lips closed and his jaw still, mist gathering around his silhouette before the frame dims gradually toward black.
